topic: Hang a heavy mirror on a drywall wall
core_question: How do I hang a heavy mirror securely on a drywall wall? (secondary: How do I get mud off suede shoes?)
answer_summary: Locate studs with a stud finder and mount into them when possible; otherwise use heavy-duty drywall anchors like toggle bolts rated for the mirror's full weight.; after the topic shift: Never scrub wet mud into suede — let it dry completely first, then brush it off with a suede brush; treat any leftover shadow with a suede eraser.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there
